title: Coefficient norm of the wedge of a 1-form with a k-covector: |β ∧ γ| ≤ ‖β‖·|γ| (fact (E1) behind Simon Ch. 6, 4.11)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let β : ℝ^P → ℝ be a continuous linear functional with operator norm ‖β‖ and γ a k-covector on ℝ^P (Covector (Euclid P) k). Let β ∧ γ be the (k+1)-covector ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight γ), i.e. (β ∧ γ)(v_0, …, v_k) = Σ_{i=0}^{k} (−1)^i·β(v_i)·γ(v_0, …, v̂_i, …, v_k). Then |β ∧ γ| ≤ ‖β‖·|γ|, where |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm is the Euclidean coefficient norm |α| = (Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(m−1)})²)^{1/2} of an m-covector α (e the standard basis of ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) k), covectorEuclideanNorm (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight γ)) ≤ ‖β‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm γ
